2. **CSLv3** — Caveman Spec Language v3. The notation.

> *CSLv3 is a notation system, distinct from the CSSL/SIGIL compiler language documented at the site root. **CSSL** (Caveman Sigil Substrate Language) and **SIGIL** are two names for the same language — CSSL is the full name, SIGIL is the shorthand. CSLv3 is separate: it is the notation used to write specs, reason in chain-of-thought, and drive the CSLv3 reference compiler. They share the "Caveman" density thesis but compile through different pipelines.*

The existing `index.html` § CSSL block currently reads:

> *"SIGIL grew out of CSSL (Caveman Spec/Signal Language)..."*

         CSLv3 (a separate notation system), but CSSL/SIGIL is the
         executable compiler language documented here."

```
